events.title: 4th District / State Selection Trial 2026
events.body: Official selection trial for district skaters competing for qualification in the 12th UP State Roller Skating Championship.

events.title: 12th UP State Roller Skating Championship 2026
events.body: The 12th UP State Championship hosted at Devaswom Skating Track, GB Nagar from 23rd October to 26th October 2026. Top athletes from across Uttar Pradesh will compete for state titles.

events.title: 9th UP Open State (Flat Track)
events.body: The wait is almost over! The 9th Subscription Open State Skating Race is coming to Lucknow on 18th & 19th July — get ready for two days of pure speed, thrill, and skating excellence!
